app.title: Find your way at St. Joseph's Hospital
app.disclaimer: Student prototype (CEMS Team 3). Not an official St. Joseph's Health Care London service. Directions come from the hospital's public website — always follow posted signs and staff instructions.
lang.title: Choose your language
lang.note: Translations are unreviewed academic-demo translations, not professional medical interpretation. Official English sign names and room numbers stay visible.
home.headline: Where do you need to go?
home.planBody: Before you leave home: find your clinic, the best parking or entrance, and the route inside.
home.hereBody: Scan a QR code on a sign, or choose where you are, to get step-by-step directions.
home.scanDemo: The “Find your way” QR signs are a proposal and are not installed yet.
home.helpBody: Volunteers at information desks help with directions. Language support is available.
home.noPhone: No smartphone? Follow the posted signs or ask at any information desk. This website is an extra, never a requirement for care.
search.title: Which clinic or department?
search.label: Search destinations
search.placeholder: Clinic, service or room (e.g. MRI, Breast Care, B3-030)
search.tip: You can type in your own language.
search.noResultsHelp: Try another word, check your appointment letter for the department and room number, or ask at an information desk.
search.ambiguous: Several places match “{q}”. Which one do you mean?
search.how: How search works: your words are matched against the hospital's official directory and known alternative names. No AI service and no personal data are used.
plan.title: Plan your visit
plan.whenHelp: Used only to check garage and entrance opening hours. Not stored or shared.
plan.onArrival: When you arrive, scan the QR code at your entrance (or tap “I'm at the hospital”). Your destination, language and settings carry over.
plan.linkPrivacy: The link contains only the destination — no personal information.
plan.clinicHours: Clinic opening hours aren't shown here — check your appointment letter or call the department.
park.title: Where to park
park.closedAt: Closed at the time you chose.
park.closesSoon: Closes {min} minutes after your arrival time — confirm exit arrangements with the parking office.
park.hoursCheapside: Open Monday–Friday 5:30 am – 5:30 pm. Closed weekends.
park.hoursGrosvenor: Opening hours are not published on the parking page.
park.officialClosestCD: Officially listed as the closest garage for appointments in Zones C and D.
park.mainSide: On the main-entrance side of the hospital (Zones A and B).
park.tunnel: Indoor tunnel to the Zone A elevators — officially “the safest and most accessible route”.
park.street: Or leave at street level and cross Grosvenor Street to Entrance 1.
park.elevatorDirect: The garage elevator connects directly to Zone C, Level 0 and Level 1.
park.longWay: The hospital's directions call this “a long way”.
park.busy: Garages are often full Monday–Thursday, 9:30 am – 2 pm. Leave extra time.
park.noLive: No live space information: neither garage can guarantee a spot, and this app cannot reserve one.
park.accessibleGrosvenor: Accessible spaces on every floor at the west end, next to the elevator to the tunnel and the street-level ramp.
park.accessibleCheapside: The garage map lists accessible spaces.
park.ratesGrosvenor: $4 first hour, then $2 per half hour, maximum $8.75 per day.
park.ratesCheapside: Rates are not listed online. Pay station: Zone C lobby, next to the gift shop.
park.replacement: A replacement Grosvenor garage is planned (construction expected late 2027 – 2029). The current garage stays open.
park.weekendNote: Cheapside garage is closed on weekends.
ent.title: Best entrance
ent.officialShortest: The hospital's directions call this the shortest route.
ent.hours.E2: Mon–Fri 5:30 am – 6:00 pm; Sat, Sun and holidays 7:00 am – 4:00 pm.
ent.afterHours: Outside these hours, go to Grosvenor Entrance 2 and press the buzzer beside the door to reach Security.
ent.dropoff: Drop-off area (vehicles may be ticketed after 10 minutes).
transit.title: By bus
transit.routes: London Transit routes stopping near the hospital: {routes}.
transit.stops: Stops are along Richmond Street and close to the Cheapside Street entrances.
transit.conflict: One official page lists route 15 instead of 21 for Huron Heights — check the LTC trip planner.
here.title: You are here
here.pickHelp: Choose the nearest entrance, elevator lobby or sign.
here.unknown: We don't recognise this QR code (“{raw}”). Please choose where you are, or ask a volunteer.
here.malformed: This QR link looks damaged. Please choose where you are.
here.noTracking: We only know where you are when you scan a sign or choose a place. No GPS, no tracking.
here.updated: Start point updated to {place}. Your destination and settings are unchanged.
prefs.title: Make directions work for you
prefs.optional: All optional. Change them any time — your route is kept.
prefs.stepFreeHelp: Routes never use stairs and prefer officially documented accessible paths. Not every corridor and door has been verified.
prefs.wantHelp: I'd like help from a person
navi.officialFrom: From the hospital website, starting at {origin}:
navi.noOfficial: The hospital publishes no step list from this starting point. These steps are assembled from official route segments.
navi.noVoice: No {language} voice is available on this device, so steps are shown as text only.
navi.mapApprox: Map is approximate and not to scale. Follow posted signs.
navi.stepFreeWarn: Not verified as wheelchair accessible. For a wheelchair or an escort, ask a volunteer or Security (dial 44555 on a hospital phone).
navi.tunnelChosen: Using the tunnel: officially the safest and most accessible route from the Grosvenor garage.
navi.translationNote: Steps in {language} are an unreviewed translation. Sign names stay in English.
navi.noRoute: We can't find a reliable route from here.
navi.noRouteHelp: Please ask a volunteer or staff member, and show them the help card.
navi.sameRoom: You are already at this place.
navi.elevator3: The official directions also mention “Elevator 3”, but it isn't labelled on the public map. Ask a volunteer if you want to use it.
navi.qrNoAccess: A QR scan only sets where you are — it never unlocks restricted areas.
prov.help.OFFICIAL: Stated in the hospital's published directions or map.
prov.help.DERIVED: Combined from official segments; check signs as you go.
prov.help.CONFLICTING: Official pages disagree — ask staff to confirm.
prov.help.FICTIONAL: Invented for a training demo. Not a real place.
r.zoneChange: You are moving from Zone {from} ({fromColour}) into Zone {to} ({toColour}).
r.garageDown: Take the garage elevator in the north-west corner down to Level B (tunnel).
r.garageUp: Take the garage elevator up to the street-level exit (Level 1).
r.tunnel: Follow the tunnel to the end. The Zone A elevators are there.
r.garageToElevators: Walk to the Zone C elevators inside the garage.
r.streetExit: Leave the garage at the street-level exit.
r.walkOutside: Walk outside along Grosvenor Street to {place}.
r.restricted: Staff escort only (training demo): continue with the verifying staff member.
r.elevatorsLeft: The Zone {zone} elevators are on your left.
r.elevatorsRight: The Zone {zone} elevators are on your right.
pl.stairsOpening: the opening at the bottom of the stairs
pl.walkway: the stairs and the walkway doors
arrive.title: You have arrived
arrive.notCheckedIn: This app has not checked you in. Please speak to the registration desk or receptionist.
arrive.wrongPlace: Not the right place? Ask at the desk or tap “Help from a person”.
help.title: Help from a person
help.intro: Staff and volunteers are here to help. This app supports them — it does not replace them.
help.deskBody: Volunteers at the information desks (Entrance 1 lobby, Entrance 2, Entrance 4 lobby) help with directions and general information. Some wear a button showing another language they speak. Desk hours are not published.
help.langBody: Information desks have iPads that can connect you to a live interpreter. Volunteers help with general information only and do not translate medical information.
help.langAdvance: To have an interpreter at your appointment, tell your care team before your visit, or call the switchboard at 519 646-6100 (English-only line).
help.langSign: Sign language interpreter: please tell staff before your visit.
help.mobilityBody: Wheelchairs are available at most major entrances. Ask a volunteer at the entrance, or Security by dialing 44555 on any hospital phone.
help.securityBody: Dial 44555 from any hospital phone. Security Services office: B0-401.
help.emergencyBody: Tell any staff member immediately. From a hospital phone, dial 55555 and read the room number on the phone.
help.hearing: TTY and Pocket Talker devices are available. Relay: 1-800-855-0511 (voice), 1-800-267-6511 (TTY).
help.notDispatched: This app cannot call or notify anyone, and nothing has been requested. Show the card below to a person.
help.noSmartphone: No smartphone? Ask any volunteer. These directions can also be printed or shown on a desk tablet.
help.unwell: If you feel unwell, tell a staff member now.
help.cardUnknownPlace: I'm not sure where I am.
help.cardPrivacy: No name or health information is on this card.
sec.title: Staff-only area (training demo)
sec.fictional: FICTIONAL — training only. Not a real place.
sec.locked: This destination requires staff verification. A location QR code does not give access.
sec.public: Public places — parking, entrances, information desks and reception — never need a PIN.
sec.granted: Verified (simulation). Fictional route shown for training only.
sec.noReal: This is not connected to any real hospital door, badge, appointment or database.
map.noWebgl: 3D map isn't available on this device — showing the 2D map.
map.desc: Approximate 3D map of hospital zones A to F showing the route from {from} to {to}.
kiosk.title: Volunteer / information-desk view
kiosk.body: Same map and steps as the phone version. Print the steps for a visitor who has no smartphone.
dest.b3-outpatient: Outpatient clinics registration (allergy, heart tests, lungs, pain and more)
dest.medical-imaging-c0: X-ray, CT scan, ultrasound and bone density
